name: Honey Kingdom
source:
When you receive a strange letter from your father, you learn about the inheritance he left for you before he passed away.
The inheritance is nothing more than a brothel, with some “peculiarities”.
It is up to you to decide who you will be to your employees, another master who is only interested in money,
or a savior who will arrange a much better life for them?
translation:
收到一封来自父亲的奇异书信后，你得知了他在去世前留给你的遗产。
这份遗产不是别的，正是一座暗藏着些许“特殊之处”的妓院。
在员工们眼中，你究竟会成为又一个唯利是图的冷酷老板，
还是为她们安排美好新生活的救星？一切全由你决定。
